title: NASA Black Hole Visualization Takes Viewers Beyond the Brink
contents: Supercomputer visualization of a camera flying toward a supermassive black hole, orbiting through the warped glowing accretion disk and plunging across the event horizon. Opens with NASA's text card 'Have you ever wondered what it would look like to fly into a black hole?'.
